notes: Economy never recovered from the Behold!/Tomorrow's Headline tag pressure: it sat at 0-3 credits paying to remove tags for most of the game, and on T8 it facechecked Ping with 2 credits. On T9 and T10 it ran R&D, passed Congratulations! and jacked out. On T15, at 6 points, it ran the trap in Server 5 and the asset in Server 7 instead of the advanced Tomorrow's Headline in Server 6 behind the already-passed Doomscroll, which was a missed win. On T20-21 it ran five times into Piranhas, which could not let it through with HQ bigger than the grip, and threw away five cards.

Won against a passive Runner, but it spent T3-T4 only clicking for credits on a full hand and discarded at the end of T4. On T7 it installed Project Yagi-Uda in Server 3 and did not rez the ice there, so it was stolen the same turn; the Hybrid Release, Fujii and Sericulture scores were otherwise clean.

No coherent plan: on T1-T2 it made eight runs on a 3-4 card HQ that kept showing the same Hammer and Luana Campos, then from T3 to T16 it clicked for credits up to 58 without ever installing a breaker or playing its 5-card grip. It left every Server 1/3 score uncontested (Above the Law T2, Divested Trust T5, Transport Monopoly T7, Divested Trust T14, Above the Law T17) and only facechecked Akhet (T8) and Afshar (T13) with no breaker.

It left R&D unprotected T1-T5, which the Runner ran six times without cost, but it fast-advanced Project Ingatan twice behind Hagen and won with Méliès City Luxury Line on T8. The Superconducting Hub stolen from Wave-only HQ on T7 was minor.

The early steals were good (Post-Truth Dividend with Jailbreak T2, Stoke the Embers with Window of Opportunity T3), but from T5 to T15 it just clicked for credits and spent 3 per turn with Tremolo on Ping for a single R&D access while holding 5 cards it never played. It made a pointless 0-credit Archives run into Increased Drop Rates on T11 and never had the money to contest Server 2, where the Corp scored out.

On T2 it advanced Architect Deployment Test, which Ansel 1.0 had installed in a naked remote, instead of protecting it, and it was stolen. HQ kept only Ablative Barrier all game despite being run nearly every turn, and on T13, with 18 credits, it played double Hedge Fund and Sprint while Project Ingatan sat in HQ and was stolen. The 3-ice Server 3 scoring of Méliès and Ingatan was solid.

It correctly identified the cheap Paywall on R&D and pressured R&D every turn, using Self-modifying Code for Gauss on T6, and won with a double R&D run on T10. Minor oddities were paying 2 to clear a tag at 2 credits on T3 and the early Grubber facecheck that drained 6 credits.

After T4 it clicked for credits up to 70 for the rest of the game, never playing its 5-card grip and never running R&D again even though that ice was never rezzed. Its only runs were unbroken facechecks into Descent (T16, T18) and Akhet (T20), and it let Above the Law, Divested Trust, Transport Monopoly and the final Above the Law score without real contest.

On T2, Mitosis put two Hybrid Releases into naked remotes against a Runner with 7 credits, and both were stolen. It went to 0 credits on T4-T5, and Regenesis was stolen from Anemone-only Server 6 on T6. On T13 it clicked for credits with Sisyphus Protocol in HQ behind only Anemone, and that steal lost the game.

Solid Jinteki play: it scored Hybrid Release on T1, then used the net-damage ice in Server 3 (Saisentan, Anemone) to score Regenesis, two Lotus Haze and Sisyphus Protocol. The only lapses were leaving R&D open on T1 and the money squeeze after Chastushka on T7-T8.

Server 1 was protected by a lone Paywall that Gauss broke for 1, yet it put Embedded Reporting (T8) and Tomorrow's Headline (T9) there back to back and both were stolen. Tomorrow's Headline (T16) and Next Big Thing (T17) were then stolen through Server 2's Unsmiling Tsarevnas, which have no end-the-run subroutine. It also spent two Public Trails on T10 and an Oppo Research on T9 tagging the Runner without ever punishing the tags.

Good start, stealing Above the Law from open R&D on T1, Transport Monopoly on T2 and Divested Trust through Ballista on T6, but after Measured Response on T5 the economy stayed thin. It wasted T4 on an Archives run and a draw into a discard, and from T9 on it kept running R&D with Banner while the Server 1 agendas (Above the Law T11, SDS Drone Deployment T13) scored behind Afshar, which it could not break.

It won, but from T12 to T16 and again on T19 it clicked for credits three times a turn with 6-20 credits and discarded a card at the end of each turn instead of developing. It tagged with Public Trail (T5, T8) and Oppo Research (T6) without any follow-up, and on T12 it clicked for credits instead of advancing the Embedded Reporting in Server 1, which was stolen that turn.

Aggressive and effective early pressure with Jailbreak and Transfer of Wealth on T1, open R&D and HQ, and Fujii from HQ for the T8 win. The main slip was T4: it made three R&D runs that each hit the Mavirus in the R&D root for 1 net damage without trashing it, dropping to 1 card in grip.

On T4, with 10 credits, it spent Tread Lightly on an Archives run and ignored the twice-advanced card in Server 1 (Fujii Asset Retrieval, scored T5). On T10 it again left the fresh install in Server 1 alone (Longevity Serum, scored T11). It made repeated empty Archives runs (T2, T4, T6, T8, T9, T11) and installed a second Red Team on T9.

It built a 4-ice Server 2 and never installed anything in it, keeping agendas in HQ behind a single Hagen instead: Megaprix Qualifier and Superconducting Hub were stolen on T4, Project Ingatan on T12 and Méliès City Luxury Line on T13. On T12-T13 it clicked for credits at 21-28 credits with 6 cards in HQ.

Strong steals of Transport Monopoly (T3) and SDS Drone Deployment (T4) through Akhet with Banner, but T5-T8 were passive economy turns. On T9 it used Raindrops Cut Stone on an empty Server 1, losing Cookbook and Leech to Hammer, then discarded 5 at end of turn. On T10 it skipped the newly installed Divested Trust, which the Corp scored, before winning through R&D/HQ with Buzzsaw.

It opened with three ice and no economy and sat at 1 credit through T3-T5, so Flower Sermon in Server 1 stalled and was stolen on T5. On T11 it spent two clicks and 4 credits trashing Fencer Fueno while Project Yagi-Uda sat in HQ behind only Diviner, and that steal ended the game.

It scored Méliès via Seamless Launch on T4 but stayed at 0-3 credits for the whole game, so the R&D ice was never rezzed and the Runner made about twenty free R&D accesses. It installed ice on Archives on T7, rezzed Otto Campaign on T9 instead of keeping money for ice, and the T9 Sprint shuffled cards into the open R&D before two Megaprix Qualifiers were stolen.

A good start: Remastered Edition via Into the Depths on T1 and Next Big Thing with Nanuq on T4. It then spent all of T7, T8, T9, T11 and T13 clicking for credits at 18-27 credits with a full grip and no pressure on R&D or HQ, though it still checked the Server 1/4 installs in time to win on T14.
